title: C++: Singleton Pattern
description: Implement the Singleton design pattern for a Logger class.

steps.title: Singleton Logger
steps.description: Create a `Logger` singleton class with a private constructor, static getInstance() method, and a log(string msg) method. Demonstrate that only one instance exists by logging from multiple call sites.
hints: static Logger& getInstance() { static Logger instance; return instance; }
Delete copy constructor and copy assignment.
